name: Machine Seated Leg Curl
movementPattern: Knee flexion - seated machine with hip flexion
grip: Hands gripping side stability handles beside the seat.
description: Flex knees against a padded lever roller while seated with thighs locked under a support pad, placing the hamstrings in a lengthened hip-flexed position for superior hypertrophy.
setup: Adjust the backrest so your knees align directly with the machine's pivot axis when seated upright.
Lower and secure the thigh restraint pad firmly over your lower thighs just above your knees.
Position the lower roller against the backs of the lower calves just above the heels, following the machine adjustment instructions; do not place it against the fronts of the shins.
Grasp the side stability handles to secure your hips down into the seat.
instructions: Curl your heels downward and backward toward the underside of the seat by flexing your knees.
Continue curling through a complete arc until knees are flexed past 90 degrees.
Squeeze your hamstrings forcefully at peak contraction.
Slowly extend your knees under complete control, resisting the weight stack until legs are almost fully extended in front.
cues: Drive heels back under the seat.
commonMistakes: Failing to secure the thigh pad, causing thighs and hips to lift during the curl.
Letting the weight stack slam at the top of the extension.
Cutting the curl short before reaching full 90+ degree knee flexion.

logging.example: Weight stack pin set to 45 kg: record 45 kg selected machine load.
logging.note: Cam profiles and leverage vary between manufacturers; record the selected stack pin load.

variantNote: Seated machine hamstring curl. Seated hip flexion lengthens the hamstring muscles at the pelvis, providing greater passive and active stretch-mediated hypertrophy than lying leg curls.
reviewNotes: Drafted from FitTrack ID 15 (Machine Seated Leg Curl).

2026-10-21: Rebuilt the knee-level lever and moved the lower roller from the shin side to posterior lower-calf contact. Earlier incorrect shin-contact attempts were rejected. Actual roller adjustment and machine geometry remain unverified.
